$comment: Hand-authored catalog for the 7.0 standard skills package.
domain web | documents | markdown | github | developer | desktop | cross-cutting
Descriptions are written trigger-first and kept short on purpose: Codex
trims the skill catalog to two percent of the context window (about 8,000
characters) and shortens descriptions under pressure. Helpers are neither
user- nor model-invocable, so they never enter a catalog and may run a
little longer. Routers are the only entries the model sees by default.
aliases are names that used to exist as separate agents and now resolve to
this skill. They are documented in AGENTS.md, not shipped as directories.

accessibility-lead.title: Accessibility Lead
accessibility-lead.description: Web UI accessibility lead. Use before writing or changing HTML, JSX, TSX, Vue, Svelte, CSS or templates. Picks specialists and merges their findings.

web-accessibility-wizard.title: Web Accessibility Wizard
web-accessibility-wizard.description: Guided WCAG 2.2 audit of a web app or site, phase by phase, with severity scores, a written report and optional fixes.

developer-hub.title: Developer Hub
developer-hub.description: Start here for Python, wxPython, desktop app, NVDA add-on and accessibility tooling work. Routes to the right specialist.

github-hub.title: GitHub Hub
